authoring: Gameplay geometry (our layer). Rig tuning constants (F/MATS/GAIN/BIAS/LN) stay in the rig. Derived from the rig SHA above; a rig reshape re-opens this file.
extractor_contract: per section: rig export -> this sidecar -> absent section = hull does not support the feature (not an error).

DECK.note: Sole between the collars, transom to the fore bulkhead. Walk-around: the console splits it fore/aft but does not close it. The collar itself is NOT walkable and NOT a washboard — see COLLAR.

COLLAR.note: The inflated tube is a boarding surface and a fender, never deck. Treat as an impassable soft rim of radius 0.270 m swept along the sheer; crew step over it, casualties are pulled across it.

MOUNTS.note: Twin fit. Blit the same single-engine layer twice at MOTOR.mountOffset(dir,mx); far engine first. The clamp sits ON skiffMotorRig's own swivel axis (y=-3.57, z=0.72), so ZodiacIso.motorOffset(dir,opts) is the pivot difference alone.

POSES.note: Feed ONE pose object into every layer of a frame — hull, both motor parts, beacon, searchlight — and into the anchor calls, or the layers shear. yaw is new on this rig: it rotates the boat about its own z BEFORE roll/pitch, which is what lets a heading-locked sprite show crab.

turn.note: She banks INTO the turn; positive s is starboard.

_excluded.PAINT: Fixed livery, hand-tuned ramps. No SCHEMES, no rampFrom, no paint slot — a service boat is not repaintable, and her orange sits above the fleet C_CAP of 0.115 on purpose.
_excluded.washboards: Open boat with a collar instead of a rail — absence is data.
_excluded.tubs: No fish-tub anchors. She is not a fishing boat; the aft sole is kept clear for a casualty.

_split.why: The drop ships ONE document with builds.hurricane and builds.frc. A sidecar names its HULL (#541), and DeckSidecarReader reads DECK/WASHBOARD/CLEATS at the top level, so each build is hoisted into its own file.
_split.transform: builds.hurricane.* -> top level, verbatim; frame.LOA_m := builds.hurricane.LOA_over_tubes_m (7.28 m), because the reader looks for frame.LOA_m and this document carries the LOA per build. No polygon, cleat or station value is altered.
_split.sha_unchanged: Both builds come from the same rig file, so both keep the drop's own derivedFromRigSha256, which matches the committed zodiacIsoRig.js exactly.
